description: What changed in hiring, day by day: jobs newly posted, taken down, reopened, or edited (title, location or salary), read daily from every job board in the directory. Call it each day with since set to the last day you saw, rather than re-reading every board. Omit companies for the whole market, or filter by kind and title words.

companies.description: Company or board names. Omit for every company in the directory.

offset.description: Skip this many, to page through a long day.

q.description: Only jobs whose title contains this, e.g. 'engineer'.

since.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the latest published day.

until.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the latest published day.

name: job_changes
title: Jobs opened, closed or changed
